messages:
lena-support: FYI escalation for ticket #78934 — acme-inc is asking for verifiable proof that a DPA erasure completed. They say their user id 'db-user-4372' was removed via our API but regulator asks for audit evidence + KMS/HSM access logs. They provided a request id: req_zzz_123 and a timestamp: 2026-02-10T11:22:33Z. Can privacy/infra confirm what artifacts we can produce?

mike-privacy: We can produce an audit log export + an HSM access summary. Specifically customer will want: 1) audit log entry showing the DELETE (with event id and checksum), 2) KMS key access events (unwrap/decrypt) that correspond to the deletion operation, 3) confirmation about backups/replication scope & retention windows (when/how long copies could exist), and 4) list of subprocessors handling EU data. We typically include a SHA256 of the export and a short explanation of fields.

josh-infra: I can pull the audit export. Quick Qs: is "db-user-4372" the opaque internal object id or customer-visible id? Also need the KMS key id used — customer mentioned "redwood-prod-kms-1" but need to confirm. I'll run a time-bounded query around 2026-02-10T11:22:30..11:22:40Z and include audit_event_id, performed_by, request_id, and object_hash.

lena-support: Customer says db-user-4372 is the external id they use in app logs; they included our request id req_zzz_123 which maps to internal req-id r-9f3b. They also asked for HSM attestation that no key material left the HSM and that unwrap operations are logged. They need the report in EU English and attached to the ticket as a PDF.

josh-infra: Got it. Running query now. Example of the curl they used (from customer):
```
curl -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -d '{"user_id":"db-user-4372","reason":"user request"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/acme-inc/users/delete
```
I can match request headers -> request_id r-9f3b -> audit_event ae-881234. Found event: 2026-02-10T11:22:34Z audit_event_id=ae-881234 action=DELETE subject=acme-inc:user:4372 performed_by=api-key-live-45f scope=eu-west-1 object_digest=sha256:6b8f... request_id=r-9f3b.

josh-infra: For KMS/HSM: key_id=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/redwood-prod-kms-1. HSM shows an unwrap record at 2026-02-10T11:22:34Z with hsm_audit_id=ham-44217 and mechanism=EC-DAA. We do not export raw key material; we export the access event details (timestamp, operation, caller id, HSM module id) and an HSM-issued attestation statement.

mike-privacy: Good. For the regulator we should include: - audit log export CSV (columns: timestamp, audit_event_id, action, subject, object_digest, performed_by, request_id) - KMS/HSM access summary (timestamp, hsm_audit_id, key_id, operation, module_id) - mapping file showing request_id -> internal request mapping (signed) - statement on backups: snapshots retained for up to 30 days; provide exact snapshot ids and whether the object appears there. Also include a short note on subprocessors: list current ones handling storage and backups in EU.

lena-support: Customer additionally asked whether deleted data is replicated to any non-EU subprocessor. Please include a disclaimer if any replicate copies existed and what our purge windows are.

josh-infra: I'll export audit CSV and HSM summary, then produce a tarball with a SHA256 checksum. Prep steps I'm running: 1) run audit query -> produce ae-export.csv 2) run HSM audit API -> produce hsm-summary.csv 3) snapshot scan for object_digest 6b8f... -> results.json (if any) 4) generate signed mapping.txt (signed by infra key) 5) assemble PDF explanation (eu-english). ETA ~3 hours.

privacy-bot: Ticket #78934 updated: audit export (ae-export.csv) attached to internal ticket.

mike-privacy: When you have the artifacts, we should route them through legal for final wording and then attach to the support ticket as a formal DPA erasure proof package. Also confirm cost center for generating the official attestation (customer requested signed PDF).

lena-support: Perfect — please post the artifacts to the ticket and drop a quick summary here when done. I'll request legal sign-off and send to the customer. :thumbsup:
